svg.style: background: transparent; background-color: transparent; color-scheme: light;

g.text: WORKING FAAS LAB | Managed VPN gateways and Check Point CloudGuard firewall
Two tenants | Four managed VPN gateways | One Route Server | Check Point gateway + separate management server per environment | Two IPsec connections

text.tspan: BGP-learned default to the Check Point gateway
for E-W and egress. Ingress IPsec: static (no BGP).
Ubuntu option: NVA pair + internal LB.

g.text: Provider security VNet | Check Point CloudGuard option
Workload subnet | NSG and route table
Workload subnet | NSG and route table

text.tspan: Blue: customer steering. Orange: IPsec, with BGP on delivery.
Teal: provider forwarding. Dashed red: provider-internal management.
Dashed purple: ingress Route Server BGP with the gateway.
Route Server exchanges routes; it does not carry packets.
Check Point is a lab preview: VMs, SIC, policy and BGP setup verified; customer traffic pending.
Earlier traffic tests used the Ubuntu simulator. Single gateway; failover was not tested.
E-W keeps customer IPs (no NAT); egress hide NAT covers RFC1918. Inbound DNAT tests were removed.
East-west was reachable before VPN connection; fail-closed behavior is not established.
